summary: Added the Ollama extension's web-side UI (OllamaPanel.svelte, store, types, format helpers, CSS, and web extension entry) plus a registry catalog entry, with a vitest web test suite. Verified TypeScript checks, prettier, the full test suite, and live exercised the server extension against a stub Ollama on :11434.
decisions: Registry catalog entry for Ollama uses 4-space (not tab) indentation, matching the file's actual whitespace
Web bundle keeps its own copies of formatting helpers and store/inspector contracts rather than importing from server/app, to keep the bundle free of node builtins
UI uses text labels only (no lucide icon dependency) to match the rest of the registry's web extensions
Stub Ollama server used for end-to-end verification instead of installing real Ollama (~1GB), since it isn't on this machine
errors: First edit attempt on gizmo.registry.json failed with whitespace mismatch (used tabs instead of the file's spaces); corrected after inspecting with cat -A and retried successfully
Top-level await in a /tmp tsx script failed under esbuild CJS output; moved the smoke script into the repo (.smoke/host-status.ts) where the package is ESM, after which it ran fine
Initial vitest run had 1 failure (details not captured in transcript) out of 43 tests; later the live exercise script ran all expected cases successfully
